title: Mako-san wa Shindemo Jiritsu Shinai
titleNative: マコさん死んでも自立しない
synopsis: It's been a whole year since Rin Touno moved to a boarding house in Tokyo in order to attend high school. Back then, the landlord made Rin an offer he couldn’t refuse: if he looked after the landlord’s granddaughter, he wouldn’t have to pay any rent. However, said granddaughter, Mako Kurihashi, turned out to be a sloppy 20-year-old college student who’s not only completely incapable of taking care of herself, but also repeatedly teases Rin for being younger than her! Despite this, though, Rin fell madly in love with Mako at first sight, and he's been taking care of her ever since they began living together. And little did he know that Mako feels the exact same way about him.

These two, who seem to live in completely different worlds, are actually step-siblings—and secretly live together as a couple. And none of their classmates know the truth. While Sakura sparkles at school, once she's home she relaxes completely and falls head over heels for Ori's cooking. And Houri, who’s in charge of meals, doesn’t mind one bit—— “Simmered fish is sooo good~♡” “Onii-chan's cooking really is the best~!” A sweet and fluffy feeding story about a cute gyaru and their double life at school and at home! synopsis: Despite her hidden genius, Avril has lived a life of misery, constantly belittled as useless by her own family. When she is forced to substitute for her wicked step-sister in a marriage to a supposedly lecherous, old duke, Avril expects the worst. But surprisingly, Duke Dylan is actually a breathtakingly handsome young man. He offers her a deal: act as his villainess wife for three years, and then they will divorce. For Avril, this contract is a golden ticket to her ultimate freedom. But as she enthusiastically embraces her new evil persona, her mysterious charm leaves the duke and his household completely bewildered and entirely enchanted. (Source: Kadokawa)
